name: Arakawa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Arakawa ward emblem in white: an outlined ring crossed by horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Arakawa, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 2 May 1950.

features.role: Arakawa ward emblem — an outlined ring crossed by horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character
